scope: Q4 target/Q4 draft performance research. No production source, numerical policy, model artifact, test executable or tool is changed. All candidates are isolated temporary microbenchmarks; the qualified release remains unchanged.

last_tile_barrier.decision: Reject both loop forms. Skipping the final reuse barrier preserves outputs but regresses up/down/medium. No register or scratch improvement; the candidate adds a vector-condition branch and four static instructions.

measurements.method: Actual Q5 GGUF, batch8, production geometry. Original vs source clone vs conditional final barrier vs loop exit before final barrier. The barrier after computing a tile protects LDS overwrite on the next iteration; the final tile has no overwrite. All workgroup threads take the same loop exit. Two full-mantissa input seeds; every output finite/bit-exact before timing.12balancedroundsx6rotations through16tensors.

last_tile_barrier.quality: Two full-mantissa seeds, all outputs finite and bit-exact across sixteen actual tensors for each of three Q5 shapes. Original and clone have identical instruction hashes.

integer_matrix_instructions.method: Q5 packed codes remain exact. Encode each32-element activation group into three/four fixed-point bytes using a shared binary exponent. Native integer WMMA consumes unsigned lower bytes and a signed highest byte, then FP32 reconstructs/scales each group. Activation preparation is included once per projection. Integer partials are bounded by32*31*255=252960 and cannot overflow int32.
integer_matrix_instructions.quality_limit: Different arithmetic from production. Four components slightly improve the sampled FP64 operator RMSE; this is not model quality equivalence. Three components are less accurate in this probe. All variants are finite and retain first-token B1/B8 equality.

Three/four byte fixed-point activation components, unsigned lower bytes and signed highest byte, native integer WMMA. Changes arithmetic, not qualified model behavior.

integer_matrix_instructions.coalesced_contract: Stage consecutive K groups from each output row through adjacent threads, decode once, and use padded LDS for native matrix fragments. Each staged8/staged16 result must equal its respective direct8/direct16 result across every output. That comparison passes. Increase K splits only in this new algorithm, to16/32.
integer_matrix_instructions.decision: Reject. Initial best four-component B8 takes0.555781ms versus0.332223ms production (+67.29% time). Coalescing improves the revised direct8 variant, but staged8 still takes0.5778485ms versus0.324425ms production (+78.11% time). Larger splits do not close the gap. No spilling; lower VGPR counts and fewer static instructions do not imply higher throughput.
integer_matrix_instructions.comparison_limit: Compare each candidate only with its own harness control. Rewriting the loop for shared staging changes direct-path code generation; its absolute rates are not interchangeable with the initial harness.

block_limit.finding: The current Q4 draft checkpoint supports seven proposals plus its committed anchor. The controller does not truncate a larger trained block in this artifact.

limits: No production change or fresh model quality/speed sweep. Current qualified release evidence remains in dflash2-synchronization.json.
Operator accuracy and B1/B8 equality do not qualify changed target distributions or establish original-checkpoint fidelity.
No75-question capability comparison; no new execution switch, maintained tool or test.
The full performance objective remains open.

staging_followups.scope: Q4 target/Q4 draft performance investigation. Temporary operator probes only; production, maintained tests/tools, weights, sampling and controller are unchanged.
decisions: Reject distributed float4 activation staging: throughput falls 3.88–12.15% across the three Q6/IQ4 cases.
Reject Q5 weight decoding before the staging barrier: throughput falls 11.05–21.77%.
Making the Q5 unsigned coefficient range explicit restores native byte-to-float conversions, but early decoding still loses 9.56–20.40%; the unsigned late-decode control is flat.
All checked outputs remain finite and bit-identical, and every compiled projection variant has zero private scratch. Lower register counts and more paired FMAs do not imply faster execution.
No full-model or speed-matrix rerun is warranted for rejected temporary kernels. The qualified production release remains unchanged.

distributed-staging.method: Q4 target GGUF, whole-file read-only host registration. Batch 5: Q6 vocabulary projection W16/R3/T2/min1; IQ4_XS FFNs W16/R4/T2/min4. Distributed float4 activation staging versus production and an unchanged clone. Preserve all dot/reduction arithmetic, LDS layout and weights. Every output finite/bit-exact under full-mantissa seeds 19 and 971 before timing. Six rotated-order rounds, eight rotations through up to eight same-shape tensors.

predecode-stage.method: Q4 target GGUF, read-only mapped weights, Q5 batch 5: FFN-down and 5120x6144 use W16/R4/T1/min4; 6144x5120 uses W8/R4/T1/min4. Production versus unchanged clone versus quantized weight decoding moved before the activation-staging barrier. Same coefficients, dot products, summation order, memory layout and allocations. Finite bit-exact outputs under full-mantissa seeds 19/971, then six balanced rounds with eight rotations over up to eight matrices.

unsigned-predecode.method: Q4 target GGUF, read-only mapped weights, Q5 batch 5: FFN-down and 5120x6144 use W16/R4/T1/min4; 6144x5120 uses W8/R4/T1/min4. Production versus unsigned late-decode control versus unsigned weight decoding moved before the activation-staging barrier. Same coefficients, dot products, summation order, memory layout and allocations. Q5 unsigned [0,31] coefficients are explicit in the two cloned kernels. Finite bit-exact outputs under full-mantissa seeds 19/971, then six balanced rounds with eight rotations over up to eight matrices.

verification_graph_bound.method: Reuse the qualified Q4/Q4 prose trace. Clip GPU dispatch intervals to the final 75%, 50% and 25% of its first-to-last-kernel span, then merge overlaps. Includes runtime copy kernels. This bounds the benefit from removing idle alone; it is not a measured graph implementation, does not attribute every gap to launches and does not cover other workloads.
code_constraints: Verification runs direct launches. Scalar decoding already has graph replay.
Verification attention and fused RoPE/KV-write take host start_pos arguments.
Tapped features temporarily use a logits allocation that can grow.
A replay implementation must update positions, preserve capture storage and invalidate graphs when addresses or capture configuration change.

staging_followups.limits: Batch-five operator controls are not a model capability or independent checkpoint qualification. The graph estimate removes idle only from selected tail windows of the preceding qualified prose trace; no graph implementation or new release speedup is claimed. The original FP4 headline goal remains open.
